core_obligations: Reduce to the set of pairs (B, xi) with B finitely presented and xi in F(B) (proof lines 474-484).
Write the image of xi in M tensor_A B and use filteredness of N to find a finitely presented N' with the required commutative square (proof lines 486-499).
Present N', lift the map and produce the witnesses c_j (proof lines 500-505).
Define L as the kernel of A^{n+l} -> A^k and verify that the twisted tuple maps to xi (proof lines 506-516).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to finitely presented test data (proof lines 474-484).

difficulty_reason: For a ring A and an adequate functor F on Alg_A, the lemma constructs a surjection L -> F with L a direct sum of linearly adequate functors (statement lines 467-472). The proof reduces to constructing, for each pair consisting of a finitely presented A-algebra B and an element xi of F(B), a linearly adequate L with a map L -> F hitting xi -- legitimate because there is only a set of such pairs up to isomorphism; it then writes the image of xi in M tensor_A B, uses that N is a filtered colimit of finitely presented modules to find a finitely presented N' with a commutative square in which the tuple maps to zero, presents N', lifts the map, produces elements c_j in B witnessing the relation, and defines L as the kernel of the map A^{n+l} -> A^k (proof lines 474-516). The level is H3: a complete element chase with a nontrivial choice of finitely presented approximation.
